phase: I — restarting. The wave was killed mid-flight by a session interrupt, not by a bug.
state: Wave I ran for 68 minutes on 18.08 and both builders were cut off at 12:07 by the same session-level interrupt — the last thing in each log is a rejected tool call and "[Request interrupted by user for tool use]", at the same second, in two independent agents. Their committed work is on the branch (six commits, pushed); their in-flight work was still in the working tree and is being gated now before it is committed. Nothing about the game changed in the two days since: when a session is interrupted the workflow dies and there is nothing in this environment that restarts it.

verdict.summary: Critic 3.7/10 — coherence rose to 6 (its best ever, up from 3), heat and survival fell to 5 (its worst), automation 2, night 2, keep-playing 2. Blind: OURS 0, EVEN 2 (information design, onboarding), THEIRS 8. Wave H landed real work verified in the shipped frame: hostiles went from 0 of 9 findable to 9 of 9, belts from 11.7% of goods to 61.9%, and an engine flip-flag bug was found that drew every right-facing figure a full sprite-width off its tile.
verdict.biggest_gap: BOTH CRITICS, INDEPENDENTLY, NAMED THE SAME CAUSE. The critic: the automation pillar shuts down at night and the night is what the game is about — production.active_machines by phase reads 3.01 morning, 2.44 afternoon, then 0.34 dusk, 0.44 night, 0.35 deep night. An 8.6x collapse for the entire dark, caused by NIGHT_TRADES = [GUNNER, STOKER] at game/sim/citizens/citizen_defs.gd:340. The blind judge, separately: the factory never comes alive — 341 buildings, 8 machines, 0 active, staffed 0.14-0.51 while 44 citizens are employed. It moves five dimensions at once, and it is why the world looks empty: there is no factory to look at.
